### Jean-Paul Sartre on responsibility

Jean-Paul Sartre (1905–1980) approaches responsibility within existentialism. Existence precedes essence for humans: we are condemned to be free and responsible without excuses. Bad faith flees anguish by pretending to be a fixed thing. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets responsibility most directly—useful for searches such as “jean-paul sartre quotes on responsibility.”
